mentions.name: My Tiny Café
mentions.description: A progressive web app that turns the home into a tiny café: family members and guests browse a menu and order drinks (and any custom items) as if at a fancy downtown café, while the author plays barista filling each order. It sends Web Push notifications so new orders are never missed, and is built as a Nuxt 3 app with Appwrite as the backend, with rough edges but sufficient for household use.
mentions.audience: The author's wife and daughter primarily, plus visiting friends who can order exactly the available beverages so everything is ready when they arrive.
mentions.source_excerpt: An PWA primarily for my wife and my daughter. They can order their hot chocolate and their coffee as if they were going to grab something at a fancy café downtown, but instead it's at home and I'm the barista.
